title: A Museum Brochure
text:
Ana found a brochure about a new museum in the city. The brochure has colorful pictures of old paintings. It also has a map of the building. The museum opens at ten o'clock every day.

Ana showed the brochure to her brother, Luis. He wanted to see the paintings from the old town. They bought tickets for Saturday because it is free for children. Luis said the museum was perfect for their family.

questions.text: What time does the museum open?
What day did they buy tickets for?
Why did Ana show the brochure to Luis?
options: She wanted him to visit the museum with her
She wanted to sell him the brochure
She wanted him to fix the building
She wanted him to draw a map

questions.text: How does Luis probably feel about the museum?

vocabulary.definition: a small booklet with pictures and information
a building where people can see art or historical objects
small papers or cards that allow you to enter a place

paragraph_translations: Ana encontró un folleto sobre un nuevo museo en la ciudad. El folleto tiene fotos coloridas de pinturas antiguas. También tiene un mapa del edificio. El museo abre a las diez en punto todos los días.

Ana le mostró el folleto a su hermano, Luis. Él quería ver las pinturas del casco antiguo. Compraron entradas para el sábado porque es gratis para los niños. Luis dijo que el museo era perfecto para su familia.
